title: Salford Tandoori
address: 3 Tootal Rd, Salford M5 5HJ, United Kingdom

user_reviews.Name: Mubin P
user_reviews.Description: Great food, incredible staff. Current reviews don’t do justice because their portion sizes and taste are very authentic. The kitchen is open and clean- recommend for takeaways

user_reviews.Name: Georgia Andrews-Jones
user_reviews.Description: Avoid at all costs, uber eats originally said 20 minute, it then took 1hr30, driver originally went to wrong address, then took another 15 minutes. Food arrives and it doesn’t even taste good, plus they gave me the wrong naan bread, so disappointed

user_reviews.Name: Raihana
user_reviews.Description: i ordered on uber eats and the delivery was stuck- not updating. the rider had called and said they were outside so i have gone to collect the food to see no one there. i called the restaurant 5x and kept getting hung up on. the driver answered my last call with nothing but pure attitude and spite- said she was waiting 30mins but it takes me 2mins to walk out which i did…? i explained they must have gone to the wrong place/ entrance but i was told this isn’t the case and i was in the wrong. didn’t get a refund or anything. customer service is awful and nothing but attitude. my number has now also been blocked…!

user_reviews.Name: Adam Miller
user_reviews.Description:
Mixed Starter was mostly good, just the lamb was a bit rubbish. Garlic rice was tasty and the Madras was a decent enough standard curry.
Overall I'd say good value for money.

user_reviews.Name: Andy Farrell
user_reviews.Description: Don’t order through just eat. The drivers are useless, rude and obnoxious. Ended up getting a refund because the driver thought it was acceptable to drop a £60 order nearly an hour late.
